text.content: A tool is only as useful as the description that governs when the model invokes it. The mock code, the input schema, and the Flowise canvas configuration are all necessary, but the tool description is what determines whether your AI model reaches for the tool at the right moment.

rich_text.plain_text: A tool is only as useful as the description that governs when the model invokes it. The mock code, the input schema, and the Flowise canvas configuration are all necessary, but the tool description is what determines whether your AI model reaches for the tool at the right moment.

text.content: A description that is too vague produces routing failures. A description that overlaps with the knowledge base produces confusion. The precision required to distinguish two overlapping capabilities in natural language is the practical skill this lesson develops.
